name: hype-wave

Archivo Black mega-type SLAMS in word by word (every third word outlined), sticker chips carry hard offset shadows, checkerboard bands scroll, wavy ribbons roll and star stickers spin. Loud, young, thumb-stopping — product drops, sneaker culture, events, creators, promos and anything that should make actual noise on a feed.
